tools.name: insumer_attest
tools.description: Evaluate a list of 1 to 10 conditions against a wallet's on-chain state and return one signed attestation: a yes or no for each condition, never the balance. One call reads the chain for every condition in the list and returns a single attestation covering all of them, so conditions of different kinds and on different chains are combined in one signed result. A condition states what must be true of the wallet, such as a minimum token balance, ownership of an NFT, an attestation held or a registered agent ID; the type field on each condition lists the kinds available and the fields each one takes. Chains: EVM chains plus Solana, XRPL, Bitcoin, Tron, Stellar and Sui; Bitcoin, Tron, Stellar and Sui support token_balance only. The attestation is signed twice: ES256, with a kid identifying the key, and a post-quantum ML-DSA-65 signature (pqSig, pqKid). Each result includes evaluatedCondition, a SHA-256 conditionHash, and the block (EVM), ledger (XRPL, Stellar) or checkpoint (Sui) it was read at. An attestation expires 30 minutes after it is signed, or 5 minutes when it includes a delegation condition. Costs 1 credit (2 with proof: 'merkle'). An rpc_failure error (503) means a read did not complete and nothing was signed: retry, and never treat it as a no. Current chain and check counts: https://insumermodel.com/llms.txt

xrplWallet.description: XRPL wallet address (r-address). For verifying XRP, trust line tokens (RLUSD, USDC), or NFTs on XRP Ledger.

bitcoinWallet.description: Bitcoin address (P2PKH, P2SH, bech32, or Taproot). For verifying native BTC balance. Use chainId 'bitcoin' with contractAddress 'native'.

tronWallet.description: Tron wallet address (T-prefixed, base58). For verifying TRX or TRC20 tokens (USDT-TRC20). Use chainId 'tron'.

stellarWallet.description: Stellar wallet address (G-prefixed). For verifying XLM or trustline assets (USDC, BENJI, etc.). Use chainId 'stellar' with the asset issuer's G-address as contractAddress and pass assetCode (e.g. 'USDC'). Soroban contract balances not visible; classic trustlines only.

suiWallet.description: Sui wallet address (0x + 64 hex chars). For verifying SUI or other Sui coins (e.g. USDC). Use chainId 'sui' with the Sui coin type as contractAddress: '0x2::sui::SUI' for native SUI, or the full coin type address::module::Name for other coins. The string 'native' is not accepted on Sui.

proof.description: Set to 'merkle' for EIP-1186 Merkle proofs (2 credits, refunded to 1 when no proof is delivered). For token_balance or ratio_to_amount against an ERC-20, a storage proof of the balance slot (no subject field); for the same conditions with contractAddress 'native', an account proof whose balance field is the value evaluated (subject 'account_balance'); for account_code, an account proof whose codeHash is the value evaluated (subject 'account_code'); for erc7710_delegation, a storage proof of the revocation slot (subject 'delegation_revocation') on managers with an on-chain-verified layout. Supported EVM chains only (not ZKsync Era, Sei, Viction or XDC Network, and not on non-EVM chains).

declaredLimits.description: Set to 'omit' to leave decoded caveat limits out of the signed results of erc7710_delegation conditions, so a forwarded attestation does not carry the principal's spending ceiling. met, delegationHash, and conditionHash are byte-identical either way.

format.description: Set to 'jwt' to include a Wallet Auth by InsumerAPI token (ES256-signed JWT) in the response, with its ML-DSA-65 sibling pqJwt beside it. The jwt is verifiable by any standard JWT library using JWKS at /.well-known/jwks.json.

type.description: Condition type: token_balance, nft_ownership (EVM, Solana and XRPL), eas_attestation, farcaster_id (Farcaster IdRegistry on Optimism), evm_view_call (single-address-argument view function returning bool; EVM chains only), ratio_to_amount (balance >= multiple * amount; EVM chains only), ratio_to_supply (balance / totalSupply >= minFraction; EVM chains, ERC-20 only), erc8004_agent (registered ERC-8004 agent on Base; agentId required), erc7710_delegation (signed MetaMask-framework delegation validity on Base; delegationManager, expectedDelegator, and delegation required; max 3 per request), or account_code (the code state of the wallet address itself on an EVM chain; expect required, delegate optional with expect 'eip7702'; no contractAddress)

contractAddress.description: Token or NFT contract address (required for token_balance, nft_ownership, ratio_to_amount, and ratio_to_supply; ratio_to_supply requires an ERC-20 contract, no native). 'native' means the chain's native coin and is for token_balance and ratio_to_amount only. nft_ownership needs the NFT contract address (0x + 40 hex on EVM); 'native' with nft_ownership is rejected with a 400, so use token_balance for the native coin. On Sui, pass a coin type address::module::Name: native SUI is '0x2::sui::SUI', and 'native' is not accepted there. A coin type may carry type parameters in angle brackets.

chainId.description: Chain identifier: EVM chain ID (integer, includes 50 for XDC), 'solana', 'xrpl', 'bitcoin', 'tron', 'stellar', or 'sui'

threshold.description: Minimum balance for token_balance, as a decimal string in token/display units (e.g. "100", not base units). Numbers are accepted and coerced to a string. Must be > 0 when proof is merkle.

multiple.description: For ratio_to_amount: collateralization multiple as a decimal string (e.g. "10" for 'hold >= 10x the amount'). Met iff balance >= multiple * amount. Numbers are accepted and coerced. Must be > 0.

amount.description: For ratio_to_amount: per-request reference amount in token/display units as a decimal string (e.g. "100" for 100 USDC, not base units/wei). Numbers are accepted and coerced. Must be > 0.

minFraction.description: For ratio_to_supply: required share of total supply, a decimal string in (0,1] (e.g. "0.005" for 0.5%). Met iff balance / totalSupply() >= minFraction. Numbers are accepted and coerced. For project/governance tokens, not stablecoins.

decimals.description: Optional. Leave it out: the token's own decimals are always read from the chain. If sent it is only a cross-check, and a value that differs from the token's own decimals is rejected with a 400.

schemaId.description: EAS schema ID (bytes32 hex). Required for eas_attestation unless template is provided.

indexer.description: EAS indexer contract address (optional, for eas_attestation)

template.description: Compliance template name. Use instead of raw schemaId/attester/indexer for eas_attestation. Gitcoin Passport templates check Sybil resistance on Optimism.

currency.description: XRPL trust line currency code (e.g. 'RLUSD'). Case-sensitive: enter it exactly as the issuer created it. Required for XRPL trust line tokens, ignored for other chains.

assetCode.description: Stellar trustline asset code (e.g. 'USDC', 'BENJI'). Required for Stellar non-native (trustline) tokens. Use contractAddress 'native' for XLM. Ignored for other chains. Flows into conditionHash so different assets on the same issuer produce different hashes.

taxon.description: XRPL NFToken taxon filter: an integer from 0 to 4294967295 (optional, for nft_ownership on XRPL only). Filters NFTs by issuer + taxon.

selector.description: Required for evm_view_call. Canonical signature of a view function returning bool, in the form 'functionName(address)' (e.g. 'hasAccess(address)'). Single-address-argument view functions only; the 4-byte selector is derived from this signature.

agentId.description: Required for erc8004_agent. The ERC-8004 agent ID as a uint256 decimal string; the caller must supply it (the deployed Identity Registry has no wallet-to-agentId reverse lookup). Met iff the attested wallet owns the agent NFT (ownerOf) or is the registry's signature-verified agentWallet binding. Registry 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432 on Base; chainId 8453 only. Honest semantics: registration is permissionless minting, so the signed statement implies no vetting, no reputation, no endorsement.

expect.description: Required for account_code: the code state the wallet address itself must be in at the anchored block. 'none' is no code (a plain key account); 'eip7702' is the EIP-7702 delegation designator (a key that has delegated execution to a contract); 'contract' is any other code (a smart-contract wallet, a protocol, a token). The three states are exclusive on a chain. EVM chains only; a non-EVM chainId is rejected with a 400. The result is met or not met, like every type: the code and the delegation target are never returned, in any format or mode. The signed evaluatedCondition is {type, chainId, expect, operator: 'code_state'}. With proof 'merkle', the proof is an EIP-1186 account proof (subject 'account_code') whose codeHash is the proven value.

delegate.description: For account_code with expect 'eip7702' only (a 400 with any other expect): an EVM address; met iff the wallet's EIP-7702 designator points at it. Echoed in lowercase inside the signed evaluatedCondition as the caller's input; the actual delegation target is never returned.

delegationManager.description: Required for erc7710_delegation. DelegationManager contract the delegation was signed against: one of the recognized MetaMask Delegation Framework managers on Base (current default 0xdb9B1e94B5b69Df7e401DDbedE43491141047dB3). chainId 8453 only.

expectedDelegator.description: Required for erc7710_delegation. The principal address the caller asserts authorized this agent. The condition fails unless the delegation's declared delegator matches. Without it a self-delegation would read as authority, so there is no structural-only mode.

delegator.description: Principal address that signed the delegation. Must equal expectedDelegator.

delegate.description: Agent wallet the delegation authorizes. Must equal the attested wallet.

authority.description: Root authority only (0xffff…ffff, 32 bytes of 0xff). Delegation chains are unsupported.

caveats.description: Caveats the principal signed (max 16). Every enforcer must be recognized or the condition fails, with no override.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature over the delegation (hex). EOA recovery, or ERC-1271 for smart-contract principals.

delegation.description: Required for erc7710_delegation. The signed ERC-7710 delegation to evaluate. Met iff ALL of: attested wallet is the delegate; declared delegator is expectedDelegator; EIP-712 signature verifies (EOA or ERC-1271); unrevoked at the anchored block; every caveat enforcer recognized; any time-window caveat currently satisfied. Recognized enforcers: timestamp (evaluated), erc20_transfer_amount, native_transfer_amount, allowed_targets, limited_calls (the last four are REPORTED as declaredLimits: redemption enforces them, the attestation does not simulate enforcement). A delegation result that is not met carries failReason, and an attestation that includes a delegation condition expires in 5 minutes instead of 30.

conditions.description: The list of 1 to 10 conditions to evaluate. All of them are read in this one call and covered by the one signed attestation.

tools.name: insumer_compliance_templates
tools.description: List the compliance templates available for EAS attestation conditions. Each template carries pre-configured schema IDs, attester addresses, and decoder contracts for a KYC or identity provider (Coinbase Verifications on Base, Gitcoin Passport on Optimism), so a condition can name the template instead of raw EAS parameters. No authentication or credits required.

tools.name: insumer_wallet_trust
tools.description: Generate a signed wallet trust fact profile for an EVM wallet: a curated set of presence checks organized into dimensions (stablecoins, governance, nfts, staking, institutional_stablecoins, tokenized_treasuries, stablecoin_deposits, wrapped_bitcoin, names, account): 155 base checks across 27 chains in 10 dimensions. Optional Solana, XRPL, Bitcoin and Tron wallets add their own dimensions, up to 176 checks across 29 chains in 14 dimensions; optional Stellar and Sui wallets let rows inside existing dimensions evaluate. Dimensions arrive in a fixed order: the base dimensions as listed, then any of solana, xrpl, bitcoin and tron that were switched on, in that order. The account dimension holds two rows per chain on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon: contract code at the wallet address, and an EIP-7702 delegation there; a plain key reads false on both, and which contract is never named. Rows on a chain whose wallet is not supplied stay in the signed profile with evaluated: false. Every check is held or not held (present or not present in the account dimension), never a balance. The signed conditionSetVersion (currently 2026-10-08) names the check list that was run; log it, never reject on it. Returns per-dimension pass/fail counts and an overall summary: no score, no opinion. Designed for AI agent-to-agent trust decisions. Costs 3 credits (6 with proof: 'merkle'). An rpc_failure error (503) means a read did not complete and nothing was signed: retry, and never treat it as a no. Current chain and check counts: https://insumermodel.com/llms.txt

solanaWallet.description: Solana wallet address (base58). If provided, adds the Solana dimension and lets the institutional rows on Solana evaluate.

xrplWallet.description: XRPL wallet address (r-address). If provided, adds the XRPL dimension and lets the institutional row on XRPL evaluate.

bitcoinWallet.description: Bitcoin address. If provided, adds the Bitcoin dimension (native BTC presence).

tronWallet.description: Tron wallet address (T-prefixed). If provided, adds the Tron dimension.

stellarWallet.description: Stellar wallet address (G-prefixed). If provided, lets the institutional rows on Stellar evaluate (classic trustlines). Adds no dimension.

suiWallet.description: Sui wallet address (0x + 64 hex). If provided, lets the rows on Sui evaluate. Adds no dimension.

proof.description: Set to 'merkle' for EIP-1186 Merkle storage proofs on EVM token checks (6 credits). Rows whose balance is computed rather than stored (Aave aTokens, BUIDL), NFT/non-EVM rows and the account rows are declined with a reason (an account proof is available from the attest tool's account_code condition); the premium is refunded whenever no proof is delivered.

tools.name: insumer_batch_wallet_trust
tools.description: Generate wallet trust fact profiles for up to 10 wallets in a single request. Faster than sequential calls. Each wallet gets an independently signed profile with its own TRST-XXXXX ID: 155 base checks across 27 chains in 10 dimensions (stablecoins, governance, nfts, staking, institutional_stablecoins, tokenized_treasuries, stablecoin_deposits, wrapped_bitcoin, names, account), up to 176 checks across 29 chains in 14 dimensions with the optional Solana, XRPL, Bitcoin and Tron wallets; the signed conditionSetVersion (currently 2026-10-08) names the check list. Dimensions arrive in a fixed order, identical for every wallet in the batch: the base dimensions as listed, then any of solana, xrpl, bitcoin and tron that were switched on, in that order. Supports partial success: failed wallets get error entries while successful ones return full profiles. Costs 3 credits per successful wallet (6 with proof: 'merkle'); credits are charged only for successful profiles, while a pay-per-call (x402) payment covers every wallet in the request. A wallet whose reads did not complete gets an error entry and no signed profile: retry that wallet, and never treat the entry as a no. Each profile lists every check, so the response is large; by default the text is a summary per wallet (profile ID, held / not held / not evaluated counts, and the checks held in each dimension, in the fixed dimension order; the account dimension's checks are present rather than held), and the complete signed profiles are returned unchanged as structuredContent. Set detail to 'full' on the call to get the complete signed profiles as text too. Profiles cannot be fetched again, so a later call signs fresh profiles and is charged again.

solanaWallet.description: Solana wallet address (base58). Adds the Solana dimension.

xrplWallet.description: XRPL wallet address (r-address). Adds the XRPL dimension.

bitcoinWallet.description: Bitcoin address. Adds the Bitcoin dimension.

tronWallet.description: Tron wallet address (T-prefixed). Adds the Tron dimension.

stellarWallet.description: Stellar wallet address (G-prefixed). Lets the rows on Stellar evaluate; adds no dimension.

suiWallet.description: Sui wallet address (0x + 64 hex). Lets the rows on Sui evaluate; adds no dimension.

proof.description: Set to 'merkle' for EIP-1186 Merkle storage proofs on all wallets (6 credits/wallet).

detail.description: 'summary' (default): the text is a short summary per wallet and the complete signed profiles are in structuredContent. 'full': the complete signed profiles as text too, tens of thousands of characters per wallet (more with optional wallets or merkle proofs). Choose it on the call that needs it: profiles cannot be fetched again, so a second call signs fresh profiles and is charged again. Not sent to the API; it does not change the price of the call.

tools.name: insumer_jwks
tools.description: Get InsumerAPI's public signing keys as a JWKS (JSON Web Key Set): an ECDSA P-256 key under its kids, followed by the ML-DSA-65 post-quantum key as RFC 9964 AKP entries. Signatures on attestation and trust responses verify against these keys. Match an entry by the kid (or pqKid) on the response, never by position; an unknown kid is unverifiable, not refuted. No authentication required.

tools.name: insumer_setup
tools.description: Generate a free-tier InsumerAPI key (insr_live_...). No credit card required. The user adds the key to their MCP config as INSUMER_API_KEY and restarts. One free key per email, with a per-IP daily limit. Free-tier allowance: https://insumermodel.com/pricing/

email.description: Email address for the API key

appName.description: Name of your app or project (default: 'MCP Agent')

tools.name: insumer_verify
tools.description: Create a signed discount code (INSR-XXXXX, 30-minute expiry) for a wallet at a merchant. Returns tier and discount percentage, never raw balance amounts. A code that carries a discount costs one credit from the API key that owns the store; a 0% result is free. A caller using another key is not charged, and stores on a licensed platform are covered by its license. Paid discount codes requested with a key other than the store's owner are subject to an hourly limit (429; the message says when to try again). If the merchant has Stripe Connect, a coupon is auto-created. Takes an EVM, Solana or XRPL wallet. An rpc_failure error (503) means a read did not complete and no code was issued: retry, and never treat it as a no. Optional walletProof proves you control the EVM wallet: the response then says walletProven true, and the full discount its holdings earn applies, without the store's daily limit for unproven wallets. Without it the store's terms for unproven wallets apply, and discountIfProven shows what a proof would get.

message.description: The EIP-4361 message, exactly as signed

signature.description: The wallet's personal_sign (EIP-191) signature over the message

walletProof.description:
Optional proof that you control 'wallet' (EVM only; send it without solanaWallet or xrplWallet). Sign this EIP-4361 message with the wallet, within 5 minutes, with a nonce you never reused:
api.insumermodel.com wants you to sign in with your Ethereum account:
<wallet>

Prove wallet for a discount.

URI: https://api.insumermodel.com/v1/merchants/<merchantId>
Version: 1
Chain ID: 1
Nonce: <8+ random letters or digits>
Issued At: <ISO 8601 time now>
A proven wallet gets the full discount its holdings earn (under the store's tiers and cap), without the daily limit for unproven wallets. Without it, the store's terms for unproven wallets apply (see walletTerms on the merchant). A proof that fails returns 401 and uses no credit. Smart-contract wallets are not accepted yet.

tools.name: insumer_list_merchants
tools.description: Browse merchants in the public directory. Filter by accepted token, verification status. Returns company name, website, tokens accepted, discount info, and walletTerms (the store's terms with and without proof of wallet control).

token.description: Filter by accepted token symbol, e.g. 'UNI'

tools.name: insumer_get_merchant
tools.description: Get full public merchant profile including token tiers, NFT collections, discount mode, verification status, and walletTerms: what the store gives a wallet with and without proof of control, so you can decide whether to sign before creating a code.

tools.name: insumer_list_tokens
tools.description: List the tokens and NFT collections listed in the Insumer registry. Filter by chain, symbol, or asset type. The registry is a directory, not the list of what can be checked: an attestation can check any token on a supported chain, and NFTs on EVM chains, Solana and XRPL, whether listed or not. An empty result means nothing is listed under that filter, not that the token is unsupported.

tools.name: insumer_check_discount
tools.description: Calculate discount for a wallet at a merchant. Checks on-chain balances and returns tier and discount percentage per token, never raw balance amounts. Free: does not consume credits. Takes an EVM, Solana or XRPL wallet. An rpc_failure error (503) means a read did not complete: retry, and never treat it as not eligible. The check carries no proof of wallet control, so totalDiscount is what an unproven wallet gets; walletTerms gives the store's terms, and discountIfProven (when present) is what signing would get.

tools.name: insumer_credits
tools.description: Check verification credit balance, tier, and daily rate limit for the current API key.

tools.name: insumer_buy_key
tools.description: Register a new API key against a USDC payment the caller has already sent (no auth required, no email). This tool does not move funds: it submits the transaction hash and a signature from the wallet that sent the payment. Paid in USDC only, on Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche or Solana. Receiving addresses: 0xee432065474D2C852700f74e3fD81e2Bcc16a3D4 on Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum or Avalanche; 0xAd982CB19aCCa2923Df8F687C0614a7700255a23 on BNB Chain (USDC sent to it on the other EVM chains is also accepted during the changeover); 8fyEGM5tRjMocKQWaVXyM2XvvnTxR3sWdrYtug2zeLX4 on Solana (USDC sent to 6a1mLjefhvSJX1sEX8PTnionbE9DqoYjU6F6bNkT4Ydr is also accepted during the changeover). USDT, any other token and any other chain are refused and not credited. The sending wallet becomes the key's wallet: one key per wallet, and an existing key is topped up with a credit purchase instead. Non-refundable. Current prices and volume discounts: https://insumermodel.com/pricing/

chainId.description: Chain where the USDC was sent: Ethereum (1), Optimism (10), BNB Chain (56), Polygon (137), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Avalanche (43114), or 'solana'. Purchases are paid in USDC only.

appName.description: Name for the API key (e.g. your agent or app name)

senderSignature.description: Required. The wallet that sent the payment signs this exact text, five lines joined by \n with no trailing newline: "api.insumermodel.com", "Confirm the wallet that sent this payment.", "Purpose: key purchase", "Chain: eip155:<chainId>" (or "Chain: solana"), "Transaction: <transaction hash>" (EVM as 0x plus lowercase hex, Solana as given). When the signature is required, a call without it returns the exact text in a 400 and the payment is not used. EVM: personal_sign (EIP-191), 0x hex; a smart wallet is checked with ERC-1271. Solana: signMessage (ed25519), base58 or base64. A 403 means the signature is not from the wallet that sent the payment; a 503 means a smart-wallet check could not complete and the payment was not used, so retry.

tools.name: insumer_buy_credits
tools.description: Add verification credits to the current API key against a USDC payment the caller has already sent. This tool does not move funds: it submits the transaction hash. Paid in USDC only, on Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche or Solana. Receiving addresses: 0xee432065474D2C852700f74e3fD81e2Bcc16a3D4 on Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum or Avalanche; 0xAd982CB19aCCa2923Df8F687C0614a7700255a23 on BNB Chain (USDC sent to it on the other EVM chains is also accepted during the changeover); 8fyEGM5tRjMocKQWaVXyM2XvvnTxR3sWdrYtug2zeLX4 on Solana (USDC sent to 6a1mLjefhvSJX1sEX8PTnionbE9DqoYjU6F6bNkT4Ydr is also accepted during the changeover). USDT, any other token and any other chain are refused and not credited. Non-refundable. The first purchase registers the sending wallet to the API key; later purchases must come from the same wallet, and updateWallet: true replaces the registered wallet. Registering or replacing the wallet takes senderSignature from the wallet that sent the payment; a payment from the registered wallet needs none. Current prices and volume discounts: https://insumermodel.com/pricing/

chainId.description: Chain where the USDC was sent: Ethereum (1), Optimism (10), BNB Chain (56), Polygon (137), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Avalanche (43114), or 'solana'. Purchases are paid in USDC only.

updateWallet.description: Set true to replace the registered wallet with this transaction's sender. Takes senderSignature from the new wallet.

senderSignature.description: Required when the key has no registered wallet yet, or with updateWallet: true when the payment comes from a different wallet; not needed for a payment from the registered wallet. The wallet that sent the payment signs this exact text, five lines joined by \n with no trailing newline: "api.insumermodel.com", "Confirm the wallet that sent this payment.", "Purpose: credit purchase", "Chain: eip155:<chainId>" (or "Chain: solana"), "Transaction: <transaction hash>" (EVM as 0x plus lowercase hex, Solana as given). When the signature is required, a call without it returns the exact text in a 400 and the payment is not used. EVM: personal_sign (EIP-191), 0x hex; a smart wallet is checked with ERC-1271. Solana: signMessage (ed25519), base58 or base64. A 403 means the signature is not from the wallet that sent the payment; a 503 means a smart-wallet check could not complete and the payment was not used, so retry.

tools.name: insumer_confirm_payment
tools.description: Confirm the USDC payment for an INSR discount code. The server verifies the on-chain transaction receipt.

txHash.description: On-chain transaction hash or Solana signature

chainId.description: Chain where the USDC was sent: EVM chain ID (1, 8453, 137, 42161, 10, 56, 43114) or 'solana'. Bitcoin and Tron are not accepted here.

tools.name: insumer_create_merchant
tools.description: Create a new merchant, owned by the API key that creates it. The store has no credit balance of its own: that key pays for the store's codes, scans and taps, and credits in the response is that key's balance. Limited number of merchants per API key.

tools.name: insumer_merchant_status
tools.description: Get full private merchant details: credits (the owner key's balance), token configs, NFT collections, directory status, verification status, payment settings. Owner only.

tools.name: insumer_configure_tokens
tools.description: Configure merchant token discount tiers. Set own token and/or partner tokens. Replaces the existing token configuration. Max 8 tokens total. Tier discounts are whole numbers from 1 to 50; a value with decimals is refused. Owner only.

chainId.description: Merchant onboarding chain: one of the EVM chain IDs listed in this schema, 'solana', or 'xrpl'. Merchant token and NFT configs are not available on Bitcoin, Tron, Stellar or Sui.

contractAddress.description: Token contract address. For XRPL: use r-address issuer for trust line tokens, or 'native' for XRP.

decimals.description: Token decimals (0-18). Required: the merchant registry stores it with each token and rejects a config without it. 6 for USDC, 18 for most ERC-20s.

currency.description: XRPL trust line currency code: a 3-character code (e.g. 'USD'), a token name of 1 to 20 printable ASCII characters (e.g. 'RLUSD'), or a 40-character hex code. Case-sensitive: send it exactly as the issuer created it. 'XRP' is the native coin and is not accepted here: use contractAddress 'native'. Required for XRPL trust line tokens.

name.description: Display name of the token, shown in the public directory (max 100 characters). Optional.

logo.description: Logo URL for the token, shown in the public directory (max 500 characters). Optional.

threshold.description: Minimum token balance for this tier

discount.description: Discount percentage: a whole number from 1 to 50, no decimals

contractAddress.description: The same token's contract (EVM) or mint (Solana) on that network; not 'native'

alsoOn.description: Optional: the same token on other networks, up to 9 (EVM chains and Solana; not the XRP Ledger, not a native coin). The store decides which deployments count as the same token. Each network's balance is read in that token's own decimals there, the balances are added exactly, and the tier is awarded once. A read that fails on any listed network refuses the whole check (rpc_failure), never a partial total. When re-saving, carry each token's alsoOn through, or its other networks are removed.

enabled.description: true or false, never a string. false switches the own token off; leave it out or send true to keep it on.

ownToken.description: Merchant's own token configuration, or null to remove

tools.name: insumer_configure_nfts
tools.description: Configure the NFT collections a merchant recognizes, each granting a discount or recognition only. Replaces the existing NFT configuration. Max 4 collections. Discounts are whole numbers from 1 to 50; a value with decimals is refused. Owner only.

contractAddress.description: NFT contract address. For XRPL: use r-address of the NFT issuer.

taxon.description: XRPL NFT taxon for filtering by collection: an integer from 0 to 4294967295. Optional, XRPL only.

chainId.description: Merchant onboarding chain: one of the EVM chain IDs listed in this schema, 'solana', or 'xrpl'. Merchant token and NFT configs are not available on Bitcoin, Tron, Stellar or Sui.

benefitType.description: 'discount' (the default) grants the discount below. 'recognition' means holders are recognized and no discount is granted.

discount.description: Discount percentage: a whole number from 1 to 50, no decimals. Required unless benefitType is 'recognition'.

enabled.description: true or false. false keeps the collection in the configuration but switched off. Leave it out for an enabled collection. When re-saving an existing configuration, carry each collection's enabled value through, or a collection that was switched off is switched back on.

tools.name: insumer_configure_settings
tools.description: Update merchant settings: discount stacking mode, cap, the store's terms for wallets sent without proof of control, and stablecoin payment configuration. All fields optional; supplied fields replace their current values. discountCap is a whole number from 1 to 100. A wallet with proof gets the full discount their holdings earn, without the daily limit for unproven buyers. Owner only.

discountMode.description: 'highest' uses best single discount, 'stack' adds them together, 'capped' stacks up to discountCap

discountCap.description: Maximum total discount percentage: a whole number from 1 to 100, no decimals

maxUnprovenDiscount.description: Most a wallet without proof of control can get, in percent: 0 = no discount, null = the same as a proven wallet

maxDiscountsPerWalletPerDay.description: Discount codes per UTC day for a wallet without proof of control; null = no limit

usdcPayment.description: USDC payment settings, or null to disable

tools.name: insumer_publish_directory
tools.description: Publish or refresh the merchant's listing in the public directory from its current tokens and settings. Owner only.

tools.name: insumer_buy_merchant_credits
tools.description: Kept for compatibility: a store has no credit balance of its own, so a payment submitted here adds regular credits to the API key that owns the store, at a flat rate (the regular credit purchase, with volume tiers, is the usual way to top up). Submits a USDC payment the caller has already sent. This tool does not move funds: it submits the transaction hash. Paid in USDC only, on Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche or Solana. Receiving addresses: 0xee432065474D2C852700f74e3fD81e2Bcc16a3D4 on Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum or Avalanche; 0xAd982CB19aCCa2923Df8F687C0614a7700255a23 on BNB Chain (USDC sent to it on the other EVM chains is also accepted during the changeover); 8fyEGM5tRjMocKQWaVXyM2XvvnTxR3sWdrYtug2zeLX4 on Solana (USDC sent to 6a1mLjefhvSJX1sEX8PTnionbE9DqoYjU6F6bNkT4Ydr is also accepted during the changeover). USDT, any other token and any other chain are refused and not credited. Non-refundable. Owner only. The first purchase registers the sending wallet to the API key; updateWallet: true replaces it. Registering or replacing the wallet takes senderSignature from the wallet that sent the payment; a payment from the registered wallet needs none. Current prices and volume discounts: https://insumermodel.com/pricing/

chainId.description: Chain where the USDC was sent: Ethereum (1), Optimism (10), BNB Chain (56), Polygon (137), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Avalanche (43114), or 'solana'. Purchases are paid in USDC only.

updateWallet.description: Set true to replace the registered wallet with this transaction's sender. Takes senderSignature from the new wallet.

senderSignature.description: Required when the key has no registered wallet yet, or with updateWallet: true when the payment comes from a different wallet; not needed for a payment from the registered wallet. The wallet that sent the payment signs this exact text, five lines joined by \n with no trailing newline: "api.insumermodel.com", "Confirm the wallet that sent this payment.", "Purpose: credit purchase", "Chain: eip155:<chainId>" (or "Chain: solana"), "Transaction: <transaction hash>" (EVM as 0x plus lowercase hex, Solana as given). When the signature is required, a call without it returns the exact text in a 400 and the payment is not used. EVM: personal_sign (EIP-191), 0x hex; a smart wallet is checked with ERC-1271. Solana: signMessage (ed25519), base58 or base64. A 403 means the signature is not from the wallet that sent the payment; a 503 means a smart-wallet check could not complete and the payment was not used, so retry.

annotations.title: Add credits to the store owner key from a payment

tools.name: insumer_request_domain_verification
tools.description: Request a domain verification token for a merchant. Returns the token and three ways to place it: DNS TXT record, HTML meta tag, or file upload. Verified merchants get a trust badge in the public directory. Owner only.

tools.name: insumer_verify_domain
tools.description: Check a merchant's previously requested domain verification token. The server looks for it as a DNS TXT record, HTML meta tag, or uploaded file, and marks the domain verified when found. Rate limited per merchant (429 says when to retry). Owner only.

tools.name: insumer_acp_discount
tools.description: Check token-holder discount eligibility in OpenAI/Stripe Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) format. Returns coupon objects, applied/rejected arrays, and per-item allocations compatible with ACP checkout flows. The on-chain check is the same one behind INSR discount codes, wrapped in ACP format. A code that carries a discount costs one credit from the API key that owns the store; a 0% result is free. A caller using another key is not charged, and stores on a licensed platform are covered by its license. Paid discount codes requested with a key other than the store's owner are subject to an hourly limit (429; the message says when to try again). Takes an EVM, Solana or XRPL wallet. An rpc_failure error (503) means a read did not complete and nothing was signed: retry, and never treat it as a no. Optional walletProof proves you control the EVM wallet: the response then says walletProven true, and the full discount its holdings earn applies, without the store's daily limit for unproven wallets. Without it the store's terms for unproven wallets apply, and discountIfProven shows what a proof would get.

message.description: The EIP-4361 message, exactly as signed

signature.description: The wallet's personal_sign (EIP-191) signature over the message

walletProof.description:
Optional proof that you control 'wallet' (EVM only; send it without solanaWallet or xrplWallet). Sign this EIP-4361 message with the wallet, within 5 minutes, with a nonce you never reused:
api.insumermodel.com wants you to sign in with your Ethereum account:
<wallet>

Prove wallet for a discount.

URI: https://api.insumermodel.com/v1/merchants/<merchantId>
Version: 1
Chain ID: 1
Nonce: <8+ random letters or digits>
Issued At: <ISO 8601 time now>
A proven wallet gets the full discount its holdings earn (under the store's tiers and cap), without the daily limit for unproven wallets. Without it, the store's terms for unproven wallets apply (see walletTerms on the merchant). A proof that fails returns 401 and uses no credit. Smart-contract wallets are not accepted yet.

path.description: JSONPath reference to the line item, e.g. '$.line_items[0]'

items.description: Optional line items for per-item cent-amount allocations

tools.name: insumer_validate_code
tools.description: Validate an INSR-XXXXX discount code. For merchant backends during ACP/UCP checkout to confirm code validity, discount percent, and expiry. Returns valid/invalid status with reason, and walletProven (whether the code went to a caller that proved control of the wallet). No authentication required, no credits consumed. Does not expose wallet or token data.
